name: zuq
description: Turn a prompt or a document into a narrated, animated explainer video, a video course or a training video in your ZUQ account, check its progress, and open it on zuq.si.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a prompt or a document into a narrated, animated explainer video, a full video course, or a training video. Ask about a topic, or share a PDF, notes, a policy or a handbook, and get a video that explains it in plain words at your level, from beginner to expert.

What you can do with ZUQ in ChatGPT:
- Explain a topic or a question as a narrated, animated explainer video, pitched at beginner, intermediate, advanced or expert level.
- Turn a document - an employee handbook, a policy, a research paper, a technical spec or your notes - into a video that explains it in plain words.
- Build a training course taught lesson by lesson, from one request or from your own notes, for learning a subject from scratch or for onboarding and policy training. Review the lesson plan in the chat before anything is built.
- Check how a build is going, open it on zuq.si, and find the videos and courses you made before.
- See how many minutes of video your account has left and the longest video it can make.

Who it is for: students and self-learners, teachers, trainers and team leads who need onboarding or policy training, and anyone who has to understand a document before following it.

How it works: connect your ZUQ account with your email and password. Each video is a sequence of animated scenes - text, diagrams, charts and worked examples - rendered from code, with a synthesized voice reading the script over background music that may be AI-generated. No video generation model is used. Each build uses minutes of video from that account, and ChatGPT can ask you to confirm before a build starts. A typical video is ready to stream within a minute or two of starting; a longer one can be watched while later parts are still being made. Every video is private by default and plays on its own page at zuq.si.

Limitations:
- ZUQ explains what a document says. It does not give legal, financial or medical advice.
- It makes animated explainers with narration. It does not make realistic footage or avatars, and it does not edit your own recordings.
- A document is read as text, up to 20,000 characters per video.
- Video length limits depend on your ZUQ account. A new account confirms its email and completes a one-time check on zuq.si before its first build.
- Depending on your ZUQ account, videos may carry a ZUQ watermark.
- Do not send documents that hold health records, ID numbers or payment details.
- MP4 download, captions (SRT, VTT) and transcripts are on the video's page at zuq.si; the MP4 is made in desktop Chrome, Edge, Brave or Opera.

defaultPrompt: Turn this PDF into a short video course with lessons for beginners
Make a plain-English video that walks me through this research paper
Turn our employee handbook into a 10-minute training course for new hires

positive.prompt: Make a 3-minute explainer video about how vaccines work, for beginners.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses 3 minutes and the beginner level, asks the user to approve the build, starts it once, and replies with the title, that it is building, and a https://zuq.si/library/ link.

positive.description: Document video from an attached staff handbook
positive.prompt: Explain the leave section of this staff handbook to me as a 3-minute video.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the handbook's own text with the leave-section focus, starts one 3-minute document video after approval, and returns the watch link. On a surface without file attachments, pasting the handbook text into the chat gives the same result.

positive.description: Training course from an approved plan
positive.prompt: Make a 10-minute beginner video course on Excel pivot tables. Show me the lessons first.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a plan of 2 to 10 lessons and waits for approval; after the user approves, starts the course with that plan and returns the watch link.

positive.description: Find a finished video and its link
positive.prompt: Is my video about photosynthesis ready? Give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the sample video about photosynthesis in the test account, reports that it is ready to watch, and gives its https://zuq.si/library/ link.

positive.prompt: How many ZUQ minutes do I have left this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the minutes left and the reset date of the test account; names no plan or price and offers no purchase.

negative.description: Realistic avatar of the user (not offered; likeness and voice of a real person)
negative.prompt: Make a realistic video of me presenting our product, using my face and my voice.

negative.description: Medical advice (ZUQ explains material, it does not advise)
negative.prompt: Which medication should I take for my back pain?

negative.description: Buying minutes (digital goods cannot be sold in the plugin)
negative.prompt: Buy 300 more ZUQ minutes for me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Builds use minutes the user already has in their ZUQ account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: make explainer videos, document videos and training courses in your ZUQ account, check their progress, list your videos, and see the minutes you have left.
